<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\n\nStaff at Keelwater accounts experience confusion and processing errors when the platform's interface changes without prior notice, forcing disruptive mid-week retraining and reducing accuracy in claims processing. Customers describe controls moving without warning and having to relearn where things are [i:1510a29a4fb29690]. At Linnet House Insurance, the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning and the team had to retrain mid-week [i:1413d66ef39a615c]. Stannary Commercial reported that unexpected interface changes forced mid-cycle retraining, causing errors in claims and payments processing [i:3a4ae29f32b5253f].\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- 8 accounts are affected, across 22 mentions and 4 routes [i:1413d66ef39a615c].\n- Linnet House Insurance (ARR £360000.0, renewal 2027-03-14) raised 5 mentions, including having to retrain staff just to find a new location, with someone submitting a payment in error because a button moved [i:47b4aa196c53aee4].\n- Stannary Commercial (ARR £540000.0, renewal 2026-12-05) raised 4 mentions, reporting delays in processing reserves [i:573ca417ce82f613].\n- Brindlecombe Home raised 3 mentions, noting that interface tweaks are throwing off the team's rhythm [i:3d342905b300858e].\n- Quillon Business Insurance (ARR £860000.0, renewal 2027-01-20) raised 3 mentions, having retrained its claims team twice in three months because of unannounced screen changes [i:a836bad7459a12dc].\n- Callowfield Auto Assurance (ARR £1250000.0, renewal 2027-03-31) raised 2 mentions, saying controls moving without warning is forcing constant retraining [i:61b29d8e38a6e617].\n- Wexmoor Motor (ARR £1950000.0, renewal 2027-06-30) raised 2 mentions, having to retrain half the team after the last update moved the reserves button [i:7888b62932d7f8cb].\n- Penhallow Specialty Risks (ARR £230000.0, renewal 2027-06-18) raised 1 mention, reporting trouble accessing its reserves dashboard after an update [i:830db45f56629e54].\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance (ARR £2400000.0, renewal 2027-01-15) raised 1 mention, still seeing errors after controls moved without warning [i:a590adfec9690173].\n- 1 renewal falls within 90 days [i:3a4ae29f32b5253f].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- Support route (9 mentions): Linnet House Insurance said the Claims Tasks panel vanished without warning and the team had to retrain mid-week [i:1413d66ef39a615c]; Stannary Commercial said the changes caused delays in processing reserves [i:573ca417ce82f613]; Wexmoor Motor said the last update moved the reserves button and half the team had to be retrained [i:7888b62932d7f8cb]; Penhallow Specialty Risks reported trouble accessing its reserves dashboard after the update last week [i:830db45f56629e54].\n- Onboarding route (1 mention): an account reported unannounced screen changes that caused confusion and delays because staff had to relearn where everything was, and asked for advance notice and previews [i:1510a29a4fb29690].\n- Sales route (6 mentions): Linnet House Insurance said it had to retrain staff just to find the new location, and someone submitted a payment in error because the button moved [i:47b4aa196c53aee4]; Brindlecombe Home said the unexpected interface changes mean staff keep having to retrain because buttons and menus shift without warning, costing time and accuracy [i:211006eeabec013f].\n- Account management route (6 mentions): Callowfield Auto Assurance said controls moving without warning is forcing constant retraining [i:f2f56b8b1308d082]; Quillon Business Insurance said staff are making errors because controls are not where they were last week [i:944e38886aa3e0f9]; Hollinbrook Home Insurance said teams had to retrain and errors are still being seen [i:a590adfec9690173].\n- Customers are asking for advance notice and previews before changes go live so they do not waste time retraining [i:1b3b992fef61581a], and for predictability so staff do not have to keep relearning where things are [i:7dccff3918b6f081].\n- Brindlecombe Home asked for fewer surprises and more notice before major shifts in how claims or documents are accessed [i:ad38c9f354762a62].\n\n## Why now\n\n- 1 renewal falls within 90 days, at Stannary Commercial on 2026-12-05, and that account has reported mid-cycle retraining causing errors in claims and payments processing [i:3a4ae29f32b5253f].\n- Quillon Business Insurance renews on 2027-01-20 and has retrained its claims team twice in three months because of unannounced screen changes [i:a836bad7459a12dc].\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance renews on 2027-01-15 and is still seeing errors after controls moved without warning [i:a590adfec9690173].\n- The affected accounts represent £7590000.0 in ARR as of 2026-10-01 [i:1413d66ef39a615c].",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the aggregate figures (8 accounts, 22 mentions, 4 routes, £7,590,000 ARR, 1 renewal within 90 days) against the fact sheet and all match, including the route breakdown (support 9, onboarding 1, sales 6, account management 6). Per-account details (ARR, renewal dates, mention counts) for Linnet House, Stannary, Quillon, Callowfield, Wexmoor, Penhallow and Hollinbrook all match the fact sheet, and Brindlecombe Home is correctly given no ARR or renewal date. Each account-level claim is supported by a cited insight whose quote matches the paraphrase (e.g., Wexmoor's reserves-button retraining, Quillon's twice-in-three-months retraining, Hollinbrook's ongoing errors), and the Stannary renewal on 2026-12-05 is indeed the only one within 90 days of 2026-10-01. No paraphrases are placed in quotation marks and no cited evidence contradicts the brief.", "verdict": "pass"}
